what: AArch64 stub of 4 instructions (request 10.3, queue 00003 item 3, still open in lane link): `table.rs` `write_stub` for Arch::Aarch64. blaze-live needs no change for it: no code in crates/blaze-live decodes a stub; `slots/model.rs` checks the two address-dependent loads (cell, then slot), which the 4-instruction form keeps (`adrp x16, cell; ldr x16, [x16, :lo12:cell]; ldr x16, [x16, #slot*8]; br x16` while slot*8 < 32768, plus `add x16, x16, #(slot*8 >> 12), lsl #12` before the load up to 2^21 slots; pad to the stub size). The x16-only form also frees x17. The test `an_aarch64_stub_reaches_any_of_2_pow_29_slots` needs a third form past 2^21 slots (today 6 instructions with movz/movk), or the capacity capped at 2^21 with an error naming it.

Stub stays 24 bytes, words past br are brk #0, fixups unchanged, capacity 2^29 unchanged. Test an_aarch64_stub_reaches_any_of_2_pow_29_slots interprets every form at 8 boundary slots.
